derived_features.availability: 270 contiguous completed eight-hour returns ending at the decision boundary.
derived_features.definition: Subtract the per-bar pure-crypto cross-sectional median return from every symbol return.
derived_features.missing_rule: Exclude a symbol with any missing, stale, duplicate, nonfinite, nonpositive-price, or nonadjacent observation; flat below 20 complete symbols.
derived_features.purpose: Remove common crypto direction without a fitted beta or regime label.

derived_features.definition: Cross-sectional centered ranks of cumulative residual return in three successive nonoverlapping 90-bar blocks, averaged and multiplied by a fixed sign-agreement factor.
derived_features.purpose: Identify durable relative leaders and laggards rather than a one-block move.

derived_features.availability: Last 90 completed returns for each otherwise valid symbol.
derived_features.definition: Cross-sectional percentile rank of a 40% downside-semideviation, 35% maximum-absolute-return, and 25% maximum-drawdown composite.
derived_features.missing_rule: The same exact complete history requirement applies; no fallback estimator.
derived_features.purpose: Capture both long-side crash damage and short-side discontinuous squeeze risk.

derived_features.availability: Computed entirely at the scheduled decision from the two preceding features.
derived_features.definition: Encode fragility percentile above 0.80 as exact zero. For remaining symbols, rerank persistence and set signed magnitude to 0.35 + 0.65 times absolute persistence rank times (1 - 0.60 times fragility percentile).
derived_features.missing_rule: Explicit flat if the captured dictionary cannot supply at least six positive and six negative symbols.
derived_features.purpose: One A5 score object supplies exclusion, side, ordering, and non-restored position shrinkage.

forbidden_inputs: funding or a reuse of either prior Team09 mechanism
portfolio equity, drawdown, positions, fills, or risk state

portfolio_mapping.gross_ceiling: 0.10 per side and 0.20 total at center
portfolio_mapping.pairing: scale only the larger captured-score sleeve downward; never scale either sleeve upward
portfolio_mapping.selection: up to eight largest positive and eight largest-magnitude negative captured scores, with at least six per side
portfolio_mapping.weight_shrink: base weight multiplied directly by absolute captured score in [0.35, 1.0]
